name: OmniSDF
aliases: OmniSDF: Scene Reconstruction Using Omnidirectional Signed Distance Functions and Adaptive Binoctrees
definition: A neural 3D reconstruction method for indoor and outdoor static scenes from omnidirectional video with small circular sweep baselines. It estimates geometry as a signed distance field (SDF) within an adaptive spherical binoctree data structure to handle large depth ranges and small baselines where ray crossings are difficult to find.
